test: PASS exact odds, enumeration, unopened double
extraValidation: 384 brute-force hand-enumeration fixtures (128 synthetic boards x 3 opponent hand sizes) matched exact hypergeometric pass odds in V8 CommonJS; Node CLI not executed
design: First reachable position per seeded complete round with two different ordinary tiles of equal pip sum, same number of accessible ends but different accessible end values. Both candidate moves are evaluated against the same actual next-opponent hand. Exact conditional uniform-unseen-pool probability is computed using all played tiles and focal hand, not opponent tile allocation. Discovery continuation policy: min-hand-pips. No win probability is inferred.
strategy: min-hand-pips discovery; paired forced immediate candidate comparison; no post-candidate rollout policy
interpretation: Across 900 selected positions, the higher predicted immediate-pass-odds action yielded 56 more actual next-player passes than its paired alternative (56/900=6.22 percentage points), with 62 pairs showing an actual pass flip. This is a model-specific immediate-pass diagnostic, not a validated increase in first-place or minus finishes.
confidenceAndLimitations: Equal-pip and equal-accessible-count matched; actual end values and opponent replies differ by construction. No exact geometry matching is possible for different tiles.
Uniform unknown-tile prior is not conditioned on opponents' earlier choices; actual simulated opponent hands are generated under deterministic policies.
First eligible per deal selection and one min-hand-pips discovery policy; cannot generalize to humans or eventual win rate.
Branch opening and double legality use recovered qosa-1.0.0 assumptions. Stock empty after initial 1-1 draw. No block winner assigned.
No new matched-strategy full-game sample: previous verified 186000 remains separate. These 1325 completed discovery rounds are tracked separately; historical 4000 rounds remain separate.
